name: H06_chandras_outrage_fizzles_when_its_only_target_is_gone
note: Chandra's Outrage has one target, the creature. The opponent's 2/2 leaves the battlefield in response (put into its graveyard): on resolution the only target is illegal, so the spell does nothing at all: it deals no damage to the creature's controller either (life stays 20 and 20), and it goes to its owner's graveyard.
